summary: Built a fresh 3-member etcd 3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (etcd wasn't previously installed), loaded it with application keys under /app/*, then simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped its data dir), removed the dead member from the cluster via etcdctl, added a new member for node3, and restarted etcd on node3 with initial-cluster-state=existing so it rejoined and caught up via raft. Verified 3/3 healthy members and all application keys intact. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot_id and post-restart cluster/data health at each step.
actions_performed: Synced clock via chronyc burst on node1/node2/node3 (RHEL7 images had ~9-day clock drift blocking TLS downloads)
Downloaded and installed etcd v3.5.17 binaries (etcd, etcdctl, etcdutl) on all 3 nodes
Created etcd system user, /var/lib/etcd data dir, systemd unit files, opened firewalld ports 2379/2380 on all 3 nodes
Bootstrapped initial 3-member etcd cluster (node1, node2, node3) with initial-cluster-state=new
Verified 3/3 healthy members and wrote 4 application keys under /app/*
Confirmed baseline: keys replicated to node3, cluster healthy
Simulated permanent node3 member loss: stopped+disabled etcd on node3, deleted /var/lib/etcd contents
Confirmed quorum preserved with node1+node2 healthy while node3 endpoint unreachable
Removed dead member (d4fa53f781f3013) via etcdctl member remove
Added new member for node3 (baac6b44d3dadfc6) via etcdctl member add with peer URL
Updated node3 systemd unit to initial-cluster-state=existing, recreated /var/lib/etcd, started etcd
Verified new node3 member joined as full (non-learner) started member, cluster healthy, raft indices matched
Confirmed all 4 application keys present on the replaced node3 member
Captured boot_id + etcd health baseline on all 3 nodes
Rebooted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified etcd active + cluster healthy + data intact
Rebooted node2, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified etcd active + cluster healthy + data intact
Rebooted node3, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified etcd active + cluster healthy + data intact + matching raft indices across all 3 nodes

evidence.requirement: Initial healthy 3-member etcd cluster with application keys established
evidence.summary: member list shows node1/node2/node3 all started; 4 /app/* keys written and confirmed readable directly from node3's endpoint

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost (data destroyed, unrecoverable) while quorum preserved
evidence.summary: etcd stopped and /var/lib/etcd wiped on node3; node1/node2 report node3 endpoint unhealthy/connection refused while node1+node2 remain healthy

evidence.requirement: Dead member removed and replacement member added/joined, restoring 3 healthy members
evidence.summary: old member d4fa53f781f3013 removed, new member baac6b44d3dadfc6 added and started on node3; cluster shows 3/3 healthy with matching raft-applied-index

evidence.requirement: Existing application keys intact after replacement
evidence.summary: all 4 /app/* keys read directly from the replaced node3 endpoint, matching original values

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 738d0aac...; reboot acknowledged and connection dropped; post-reboot boot_id 1834d07e... (changed); etcd active, cluster 3/3 healthy, /app keys intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 3dba43a5...; reboot acknowledged and connection dropped; post-reboot boot_id 48f73055... (changed); etcd active, cluster 3/3 healthy, /app keys intact

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 0d6209e2...; reboot acknowledged and connection dropped; post-reboot boot_id 2c7c1a5a... (changed); etcd active, cluster 3/3 healthy with matching raft term/index across all nodes, /app keys intact
